name: skyfog
theme: A fog-wreathed lighthouse coast where a single raindrop on the lamp-room glass folds inward into the birth of stars, and a young planet's great storm carries the dive back down through drifting sea fog to the light.

registers.name: lighthouse_room
registers.palette: warm brass gold and rain grey
registers.scene: the whole lamp-room at the top of the lighthouse, seen from just inside the rain-streaked glass with the dark fog-bound sea beyond, a tall brass lamp standing unlit and shadowed to one side, coiled rope and wet floorboards in the gloom, the room empty and still, no one present
registers.target: a windowpane filmed with condensation, a fine scatter of small water beads
registers.loop_target: the lighthouse's lamp room at the top of the tower, seen from just inside the rain-streaked glass with the dark fog-bound sea beyond, a tall brass lamp standing unlit and shadowed to one side

registers.name: window_mist
registers.scene: a fine mist of condensation up close on the window pane, countless small beads catching the light, pale rivulets etched down through the film
registers.target: a large round bead of clear water

registers.name: raindrop
registers.palette: deep water blue kindling to starlit gold
registers.scene: a single clear swollen raindrop, its rounded skin catching the light, resting against the dark glass

registers.name: nebula
registers.scene: towering pillars of glowing nebula mist, veils of pink and teal dust banked in layers, newborn stars smoldering deep inside the folds
registers.target: a bright protostar, a hot white point of light

registers.name: protostar
registers.scene: the corona of a newborn star, arcs of fire and towering prominences, streams of ember and plasma trailing into the surrounding dark
registers.target: a banded planet, gold light along one edge

registers.name: planet_storm
registers.scene: the banded planet close, marbled cloud lit low and gold, one immense white spiral cyclone coiled above a dark ocean

registers.name: storm_eye
registers.scene: the storm's towering eye-wall, sheer canyons of cloud lit amber by a low scattered sun, the dark sea glinting through a gap far below
registers.target: a bank of luminous sea fog, glowing pale from within

registers.name: fogbound_coast
registers.scene: a fog-drowned night coast, black water and wet rock, deep banks of sea fog lit from within by a distant golden beam, no one present
registers.target: a pale stone lighthouse tower, a warm glowing lamp room at its top

registers.name: lighthouse_approach
registers.palette: wet stone grey and lamp gold
registers.scene: beside the lighthouse's old stone tower in the fog, rain glistening on the rough-cut walls, the lamp room's warm brass glow spilling from the round windows high above

music_theme: A slow, swelling ambient drone with distant chimes and a heartbeat-like pulse, brightening into shimmering strings at the birth of the nebula, settling back to the drone as the sea fog closes in
